title: Callback Receiver Demo
description: Simulates a merchant endpoint receiving platform outbound notifications, for payment/refund callback integration testing

guide.title: Integration Guide
guide.usage: Point the merchant app notification URL (notifyUrl) to the endpoint below. Platform outbound notifications will be received and signature-verified here.
guide.note: Records are stored in memory and cleared on service restart.
